questions.question: What did Yuki Tsukumo do for the young Aoi Todo?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo/Synopsis

answer.item: she appeared to the elementary school student, Aoi Todo. Asking him what type of women he was into, she introduced the boy into the world of jujutsu sorcery and went on to train him in it.

questions.question: What does Geto realize is a third way to stop cursed spirits from being created?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo/Synopsis

answer.item: Geto realizes there's a third possibility: the extermination of non-sorcerers.

questions.question: What does Yuki claim is the next stage of humanity?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo/Synopsis

answer.item: the next stage of humanity is breaking away from cursed energy

questions.question: What did Geto reveal about the non-sorcerers he had marked?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo/Synopsis

answer.item: He says that he has remotely casted Idle Transfiguration on two type of non-sorcerers who have been already been marked. He reveals that he adjusted their brains for sorcery and gave them strength as vessels along with the ability to use cursed technique.

questions.question: What is Yuki's last attack on Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuki uses one last attack with Star Rage creating a black hole to kill Kenjaku.
